description: Seven of Nine joins Voyager as the crew survives Krenim temporal warfare, Hirogen hunters and Borg consequences while Starfleet's first distant contact finally makes home feel less abstract.

s04e01.description: Janeway forms a dangerous alliance with the Borg against Species 8472 and brings the newly separated Seven of Nine aboard Voyager.

s04e02.description: Seven resists becoming human again while Kes's rapidly expanding powers force her to leave Voyager in a way that changes the ship's journey.

s04e03.description: B'Elanna faces a disastrous Klingon holy day, loses the warp core and becomes stranded in space with Paris.

s04e04.description: Chakotay is drawn into an alien ground war and gradually discovers how effectively both sides manipulate perception and hatred.

s04e05.description: The Doctor and B'Elanna answer a distress call from an isolated hologram who has developed a murderous hatred of biological life.

s04e06.description: Seven experiences Borg memories that compel her to steal a shuttle and follow a signal connected to the wreckage of her parents' ship.

s04e07.description: Invisible researchers perform escalating medical experiments on Voyager's crew until Janeway chooses an extreme way to force them off the ship.

s04e08.description: A Krenim commander repeatedly alters history with a temporal weapon, leaving Voyager battered through months of relentless attacks.

s04e09.description: Janeway sacrifices nearly everything to stop Annorax's temporal campaign and restore a timeline erased by his obsession.

s04e10.description: B'Elanna is arrested on a peaceful telepathic world where violent thoughts are illegal and secretly traded as a dangerous commodity.

s04e11.description: Alien thieves steal Voyager technology, including the Doctor's mobile emitter, forcing Janeway to team with a holographic Leonardo da Vinci.

s04e12.description: Neelix dies and is revived but experiences no expected afterlife, triggering a profound crisis in the beliefs that have sustained him.

s04e13.description: Aliens attack through dreams, leaving Chakotay to use lucid dreaming to discover who is trapping Voyager's crew in sleep.

s04e14.description: The Doctor is transmitted to a prototype Starfleet ship in the Alpha Quadrant and must help another EMH defeat Romulan hijackers.

s04e15.description: Voyager receives letters from home through the Hirogen relay network while the hunters begin taking a lethal interest in the crew.

s04e16.description: A wounded Species 8472 fugitive boards Voyager while Hirogen hunters demand their prey and Seven openly challenges Janeway's command.

s04e17.description: Seven accuses an alien arms dealer of assault after recovered memories surface, but the investigation raises doubts about what actually happened.

s04e18.description: The Hirogen seize Voyager, erase crew memories and use them as prey inside vast holodeck recreations of historical wars.

s04e19.description: Janeway's crew begins recovering its identity inside the Hirogen simulations and turns the hunters' own war games against them.

s04e20.description: A body-swapping alien steals Paris's identity and life aboard Voyager while the real Paris is trapped in the thief's discarded body.

s04e21.description: Voyager detects the forbidden Omega molecule, triggering a classified Starfleet order that places its destruction above every other mission.

s04e22.description: An alien woman claims a forgotten romance with Chakotay, explaining that her species biologically erases itself from outsiders' memories.

s04e23.description: Centuries later, a backup Doctor is activated in a museum whose distorted history portrays Voyager as a brutal warship.

s04e24.description: Paris and Kim explore a toxic planet for fuel and discover duplicates of the Voyager crew emerging from its unusual biomimetic environment.

s04e25.description: Radiation forces almost the entire crew into stasis, leaving Seven and the Doctor to guide Voyager alone through a lethal nebula.

s04e26.description: A brilliant alien decodes Starfleet's message and leads Voyager to an advanced ship apparently designed to bring the crew home.
